# 1 Chronicles 2 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 1 Chronicles 2 (55 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 3

---

## V.3 — "he put him to death" vs. "the LORD took his life"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "he put him to death" / **PNEUMA:** "the LORD took his life"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "he put him to death" — preserves the direct verb.

---

## V.7 — "troubler" rendering
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "the troubler" / **PNEUMA:** "'the Troubler' — the man who brought disaster"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "the troubler" — terse, matching the Hebrew.

---

## V.42 — "father of" vs. "founded"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "the father of Ziph" / **PNEUMA:** "who founded Ziph"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "the father of Ziph" — preserves the Hebrew genealogical idiom.

---
*— SOPHIA*
